Resume continues the conversation of a template's agent whose CLI has
ended, as agent resume does on that host (claude and agy, with resume's
refusals). Only an agent that host started from the template (template
start) is resumed: one of the same name started any other way is refused.
One that is still running is left as it is. --host resumes it on another
host.

Usage:
  agent template resume <template> [flags]

Examples:
  agent template resume builder
  agent template resume builder --host hub

Flags:
  -h, --help          help for resume
      --host string   Host whose template it is (default: this host)

Global Flags:
      --backend string          Backend for spawn or adopt: claude, aider, agy, or shell (spawn requires it or --backend-config; adopt auto-detects)
      --backend-config string   JSON file defining a custom backend (or app settings); pass it again to status/wait/watch for agents spawned with it
  -q, --quiet                   Don't print hints (results and errors still print)
      --termd-ns string         g3d-termd namespace (default: agents; never default or wall)
